title: events/types/improvement.rejected
description: Payload for event_type 'improvement.rejected' (native type, feature 009; FR-803): a candidate failed a gate — metrics, audit, or deferred for thin evidence. Reasons are recorded; the candidate never activates.

gate.description: metrics = worse on replayed evidence; audit = invariant/quality failure; defer = insufficient evidence.

source_cycle.description: selfcheck cycle that produced the candidate.
